title: Project authoritative storage-layout specifics
description:
Issue-ID shape, event-file serialization, and gate-run result layout have no maintained storage projection, so adopter documentation must cite implementation directly.

Source: `crates/jit/src/domain/types.rs:16-17,547-579`; `crates/jit/src/storage/json.rs:24-39,82-89,152-179,634-670,735-775,778-812`; `dev/archive/2d109173-plan.md:31,384-403`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: A generated storage reference specifies UUID issue IDs and the eight-character human short-ID convention only where source supports it.
- [hard] REQ-02: It specifies JSON Lines events in `.jit/events.jsonl` and links to the authoritative event contract rather than copying a second tag catalog.
- [hard] REQ-03: It projects `.jit/gate-runs/<run-id>/result.json` and source-backed structured result fields.
- [hard] REQ-04: Freshness or conformance coverage prevents drift from storage code.
